decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The access doorway to the premises shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 3 - The access doorway to the premises shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.REASON: J1R. To provide satisfactory access for people with disabilities in accordance with policy ENV-B.1.1 New Development.
Full details of the access ramp at the front of the property, including gradients and cross falls of amended levels shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of works.REASON: To provide satisfactory access for people with disabilities in accordance with policy ENV-B.1.1 New Development.

Condition : 4 - Two (2) cigarette disposal bins shall be provided at the front of the premises for customers, prior to the occupation of the shop. The bins shall be permanently provided and regularly maintained thereafter whilst the shop is used as a betting office. The bins shall be either wall mounted or of a 'bollard' style fixed to the pavement within the curtilage of the site, with no part being more than 400mm from the shop front. The bins are to be a cream colour if wall mounted or black if bollards
description: Change of use from A1 (Retail) to A2 (Betting office) incorporating alterations to shop front and erection of access ramp
